steps.text: Set valid to an empty list.

Check whether 3 is at most the length of code and is at most 4 and all(('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in code[:2])) and all(('0' <= c <= '9' for c in code[2:])) and code[2] differs from '0'. Append code to valid.
Process each i in range(1, the length of valid).
Repeat while j is at least 0 and key(valid[j]) is greater than key(value). Set valid[j + 1] to valid[j]. Decrease j by 1.
Return [a list of c for c in valid if int(c[2:]) % 2 equals 0, a list of c for c in valid if int(c[2:]) % 2 equals 1].
